```{r}
# To load the packages needed
library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)
library(tidyverse)
library(scCustomize)
library(edgeR)
library(scDblFinder)
library(Seurat)
library(CellChat)
```
```{r}
# To download the dataset- BARCODE
download.file(
  url = "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/samples/GSM6190nnn/GSM6190913/suppl/GSM6190913_b1_barcodes.tsv.gz",
  destfile = "/scratch/dineshkumar.de/b1/barcodes.tsv.gz",
  mode = "wb"
)

# To download the FEATURES dataset
download.file(
  url = "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/samples/GSM6190nnn/GSM6190913/suppl/GSM6190913_b1_features.tsv.gz",
  destfile = "/scratch/dineshkumar.de/b1/features.tsv.gz",
  mode = "wb"
)

# To download the MATRIX dataset
download.file(
  url = "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/samples/GSM6190nnn/GSM6190913/suppl/GSM6190913_b1_matrix.mtx.gz",
  destfile = "/scratch/dineshkumar.de/b1/matrix.mtx.gz",
  mode = "wb"
)
```
```{r}
# After creating the matrix
#Separate gene expression and HTO data
dataset_rna_counts <- b1$'Gene Expression'
dataset_barcodes <- b1$'Antibody Capture'

```
```{r}
# Create Seurat object with basic filtering
# Create Seurat object
# min.cells = 5: keep genes detected in at least 5 cells
# min.features = 200: keep cells with at least 200 genes detected
dataset <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = dataset_rna_counts,
  min.cells = 5,
  min.features = 200
)
```
```{r}
# Get joint barcodes between RNA and HTO
# Extract RNA counts as a layer
dataset_rna_counts2 <- LayerData(dataset, layer = "counts")

# Find cells present in BOTH the RNA and HTO data
# This ensures we only keep cells that have both gene expression AND barcode data
dataset_joint.barcodes <- intersect(
  colnames(dataset_rna_counts2),
  colnames(dataset_barcodes)
)
```
```{r}
# Subset both matrices to only joint barcodes
# Keep only the cells present in both assays
dataset_rna_counts2 <- dataset_rna_counts2[, dataset_joint.barcodes]
dataset_barcodes2 <- as.matrix(dataset_barcodes[, dataset_joint.barcodes])
```
```{r}
# COnfirm HTO barcode names
# Check the 17 barcode names
rownames(dataset_barcodes2)
```

```{r}
# Add HTO as the new assay to the Seurat object
# Create a new assay from the barcode data
dataset_barcode_assay <- CreateAssayObject(counts = dataset_barcodes2)
# Add it to the Seurat object
dataset[["barcodes"]] <- dataset_barcode_assay
```

```{r}
# Validate multiple assays exist
DefaultAssay(dataset)
Assays(dataset)
```

```{r}
# Normalize and demuliplex
# Normalize the barcode data first
dataset <- NormalizeData(
  dataset,
  assay = "barcodes",
  normalization.method = "CLR"  # CLR normalization for HTO data
)

# Demultiplex — assigns each cell to a sample based on HTO signal
dataset <- HTODemux(
  dataset,
  assay = "barcodes",
  positive.quantile = 0.99
)
```

```{r}
# Remove unclassified Negative cells
# Group cells by classification
Idents(dataset) <- "barcodes_classification.global"

# Check how many cells in each category
table(Idents(dataset))
# Shows: Doublet, Negative, Singlet counts

# Remove Negative cells (cells with no barcode signal)
dataset <- subset(dataset, idents = "Negative", invert = TRUE)

# Verify removal
table(Idents(dataset))
```

```{r}
# Group by maximum HTO signal
Idents(dataset) <- "barcodes_maxID"
table(Idents(dataset))
```
```{r}
# violin plot
VlnPlot(
  dataset,
  features = "nFeature_RNA",
  pt.size = 0.1,
  log = TRUE
)
```
```{r}
# Rename barcodes to time/space labels
# Set identity to barcode maxID
Idents(dataset) <- "barcodes_maxID"

# Check current barcode names
levels(dataset)

# Rename each barcode to its biological meaning
# D = Day post-wounding, mm = distance from wound
dataset <- RenameIdents(dataset,
  "Barcode-1"  = "D01_2mm",
  "Barcode-2"  = "D01_4mm",
  "Barcode-3"  = "D01_6mm",
  "Barcode-4"  = "D01_8mm",
  "Barcode-5"  = "D03_2mm",
  "Barcode-6"  = "D03_4mm",
  "Barcode-7"  = "D03_6mm",
  "Barcode-8"  = "D03_8mm",
  "Barcode-9"  = "D07_2mm",
  "Barcode-10" = "D07_4mm",
  "Barcode-11" = "D07_6mm",
  "Barcode-12" = "D07_8mm",
  "Barcode-13" = "D14_2mm",
  "Barcode-14" = "D14_4mm",
  "Barcode-15" = "D14_6mm",
  "Barcode-16" = "D14_8mm",
  "Barcode-17" = "UW"        # UW = Unwounded control
)
```

```{r}
#save as new metadata column called time_space
dataset[["time_space"]] <- Idents(dataset)
```
```{r}
#filtering out genes and the cells with min criteria
dataset <- CreateSeuratObject(counts =
b1, min.cells = 5, min.features = 200)
```
```{r}
#switching to RNA assay
DefaultAssay(dataset) <- "RNA"
Idents(dataset) <- "time_space"
```
```{r}
# To calculate mitochondrial percentage
# mt- prefix is for mouse mitochondrial genes (capital MT- would be human)
dataset[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(dataset, pattern = "^mt-")
```
```{r}
# To visualize the QC metrics before filtering
plot1 <- FeatureScatter(dataset, 
                        feature1 = "nCount_RNA", 
                        feature2 = "percent.mt")

plot2 <- FeatureScatter(dataset, 
                        feature1 = "nFeature_RNA", 
                        feature2 = "percent.mt")

plot1 + plot2
```

```{r}
# Remove low quality cells
dataset <- subset(dataset, 
                  subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & percent.mt < 25)

print(dataset)
```

```{r}
#to visualize the QC metrics after filtering
plot1 <- FeatureScatter(dataset, 
                        feature1 = "nCount_RNA", 
                        feature2 = "percent.mt")

plot2 <- FeatureScatter(dataset, 
                        feature1 = "nFeature_RNA", 
                        feature2 = "percent.mt")

plot1 + plot2
```

```{r}
# Run scDblFinder to detect doublets
library(scDblFinder)

DefaultAssay(dataset) <- "RNA"

# Run doublet detection
# samples = Idents(dataset) tells scDblFinder to 
# treat each time_space group as a separate sample
sce <- scDblFinder(
  GetAssayData(dataset, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts"),
  samples = Idents(dataset)
)

# Check output
sce
```

```{r}
# adding the doublet score to the metadata
dataset$scDblFinder.score <- sce$scDblFinder.score
```

```{r}
# to visualize the doublet score distribution
VlnPlot(dataset, 
        features = "scDblFinder.score", 
        raster = FALSE, 
        pt.size = 0.5)
```

```{r}
# remove likely doublets
# Keep only cells with doublet score below 0.25
dataset <- subset(dataset, scDblFinder.score < 0.25)
```

```{r}
# Save the dataset
saveRDS(dataset, "dataset_post_Method2.rds")
```

```{r}
# Analyzing the dataset
#reloading the data
dataset <- readRDS("dataset_post_Method2.rds")
dataset <- NormalizeData(object = dataset)
dataset <- FindVariableFeatures(object = dataset)
dataset <- ScaleData(object = dataset)
dataset <- RunPCA(object = dataset)
```
```{r}
#Visualizing the PCA dimensions using Elbow plots
ElbowPlot(dataset, reduction = "pca",
ndims = 50)
```

```{r}
#Cell Clustering
dataset <- FindNeighbors(dataset, verbose = TRUE, dims = 1:13)
dataset <- FindClusters(dataset, verbose = TRUE, resolution = 0.1)
```
```{r}
#UMAP dimenstional reduction
dataset <- RunUMAP(dataset, verbose = TRUE, dims = 1:13, seed.use = 123)
```
```{r}
#UMAP Plot
DimPlot(dataset, group.by = "seurat_clusters", raster = FALSE, label = TRUE)
```
```{r}
#Clustering based on the time/space annotation
DimPlot(dataset, group.by = "time_space",
raster = FALSE, label = FALSE)
```
```{r}
# Generating table of cell cluster association with the wound time/space annotation
table(dataset$time_space, dataset$seurat_clusters)
```
```{r}
# Identifying the DEGs
Idents(dataset) <- "seurat_clusters"
Cell_markers <- FindAllMarkers(dataset, max.cells.per.ident = 500, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.10, logfc.threshold = 0.25)

write.csv(Cell_markers, file = file.path(getwd(), "dataset_cluster_markers.txt"))
```

```{r}
# Identifying and Enrichment analysis
Idents(dataset) <- "seurat_clusters"
dataset[["cell_types"]] <- Idents(dataset)
Idents(dataset) <- "cell_types"
dataset <- RenameIdents(dataset,
"0" = "Macrophage",
"1" = "Neutrophil",
"2" = "Fibroblast",
"3" = "Epithelial cell",
"4" = "Endothelial cell",
"5" = "T cell",
"6" = "Fibroblast",
"7" = "Smooth muscle cell"
)
levels(dataset)
dataset[["cell_types"]] <- Idents(dataset)
```
```{r}
#UMAP plot for visualizing after labeling
DimPlot(dataset, group.by = "cell_types",
raster = FALSE, label = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Visualizing top cluster marker genes
DefaultAssay(dataset) <- "RNA"
FeaturePlot(dataset, features =
c("Arg1", "Retnlg", "Fgf7", "Dsp",
"Tie1", "Cd3g", "Cdh4", "Rgs5"),
raster=FALSE, ncol = 4)
```
```{r}
# Dot plot for the top DEGs from original cluster numbers
DotPlot(dataset,group.by=
"seurat_clusters", features =
c("Arg1","Retnlg","Fgf7","Dsp","Tie1",
"Cd3g","Cdh4","Rgs5")) + RotatedAxis() +
scale_colour_gradient2(low = "blue", mid
= "grey", high = "red")
```
```{r}
#Dot plot for the top DEGs from annotated cell type
DotPlot(dataset, group.by
= "cell_types", features =
c("Arg1","Retnlg","Fgf7","Dsp","Tie1",
"Cd3g","Cdh4","Rgs5")) + RotatedAxis() +
scale_colour_gradient2(low = "blue", mid
= "grey", high = "red")
```
```{r}
# Time-series analysis
Idents(dataset) <- "time_space"
dataset[["DPW"]] <- Idents(dataset)
Idents(dataset) <- "DPW"
new.cluster.ids <- c("D1", "D1", "D1",
"D1", "D3", "D3", "D3", "D3", "D7",
"D7", "D7", "D7", "D14", "D14", "D14",
"D14", "UW")
names(new.cluster.ids) <- levels(dataset)
dataset <- RenameIdents(dataset,
new.cluster.ids)
dataset[["DPW"]] <- Idents(dataset)
Idents(dataset) <- "DPW"
```
```{r}
#UMAP plot for new time-course grouping
DimPlot(dataset, group.by = "DPW", raster
= FALSE, label = FALSE)
```
```{r}
# To generate table
table(dataset$DPW, dataset$cell_types)
Idents(dataset) <- "DPW"
Cell_DPW_markers <- FindAllMarkers(dataset,
max.cells.per.ident = 500,
only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.10,
logfc.threshold = 0.25)
write.csv(Cell_DPW_markers, file = file.path(getwd(), "dataset_DPW_markers.txt"))
```

```{r}
# Relative change of cell type through the time course of healing
pt1 <- table(dataset$DPW, dataset
$cell_types)
pt1 <- as.data.frame(pt1)
pt1$Var1 <- as.character(pt1$Var1)
ggplot(pt1, aes(x = Var2, y = Freq, fill = Var1)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
geom_col(position = "fill", width = 0.5) +
  xlab("Sample") + RotatedAxis() +
  ylab("Proportion") +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())
```

```{r}
#Visualize the proportion of cell types in each DPW
pt2 <- table(dataset$cell_types, dataset
$DPW)
pt2 <- as.data.frame(pt2)
pt2$Var1 <- as.character(pt2$Var1)
ggplot(pt2, aes(x = Var2, y = Freq, fill
= Var1)) +
theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
geom_col(position = "fill", width = 0.5)+
xlab("Sample") +
ylab("Proportion") +
theme(legend.title = element_blank())
```

saveRDS(dataset, "dataset_post_Method3.rds")
